simple.meaning: עֲרוֹעֵר (ʻărôwʻêr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a juniper (from its nudity of situation).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֲרוֹעֵר (H6176) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 17:6, with occurrences in Jeremiah.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֲרוֹעֵר (H6176) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֲרוֹעֵר (ʻărôwʻêr) / H6176 is traced through Jeremiah 17:6, Jeremiah 48:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
